description: RunBatch with op=extract + non-empty lora_key + one valid item + one invalid (extract payload missing). Pins Python adapter_call_loop invariants for the sie-worker sidecar contract: lora_key injection into options['lora'], invalid-before-valid ordering, and preserved identity for invalid payloads.

notes.rationale: expected_lora_in_options="extract-lora-v1" pins the Python-side options['lora'] injection. The invalid-item appears at item_index=0 and keeps its identity so the Rust dispatcher can publish and ACK the original work item.
